answer:
Short version: this installation draws on nothing outside itself.

There is no mail, no calendar and no incumbent mirror behind these numbers. The coverage read walks each source and returns a state; only a source it actually got into carries a date, and not one of them does.

So the figures are an honest report of what people typed in, and nobody here can currently tell a silent customer from a connector that was never wired up.
